_readme: MANUAL per-hero captures, transcribed by hand from in-game victory/defeat screens. This is the FALLBACK for battles the RslBattleReader cannot capture per-hero (the dungeon hero-context contiguity failure — see the reader forensics: per-hero DUNGEON damage is left NULL when the heap scan can't isolate the 5 fresh contexts). Mirrors the reader's heroes[] schema so it can be merged with gestal-sync/RslBattleReader/output/battle-log.json. Fields per hero: damage = red sword (total dealt), taken = blue shield (DAMAGE TAKEN; the reader's HeroBattleStatsContext calls this field 'defense'), healing = green (total done). Append new battles to captures[]. Every value is human-read — double-check against the screenshot before trusting. DEDUP KEY: `energy` is the current energy (max 109) read off the screen — combined with `timeSeconds`/`turns` it disambiguates captures. If two entries share an identical per-hero DAMAGE vector but differ in energy/time, they are the SAME battle re-viewed (dedupe); identical per-hero on a genuinely different battle = a stale-value bug (same fingerprint as the reader contiguity bug — see 9aab9e5).

captures.notes: EZIO team, VICTORY 159t / 5:08. Team-total ~3.75M: Pelops top (1.43M), Ezio 2nd (1.14M), Bambus 3rd (1.07M). ⭐ SURVIVAL TIMELINE (first-party observed, NOT full 5/5 survive): TAGOAR died FIRST ~halfway (~t80); VERGIS died ~3/4 (~t120). The two SUPPORT seats — and the two HIGHEST-taken (Vergis 32,730 MOST, Tagoar 25,986 2nd) — die, while the three CARRIES (Ezio/Bambus/Pelops) are PROTECTED (taken 9,468 / 8,202 / 14,655) and survive to finish. So reality wins Spider-13 by keeping the CARRIES alive, not the whole team; the supports are effectively expendable and the win still lands with 3/5 alive. Tagoar's unusually LOW damage (64k vs her typical 88-312k) is EXPLAINED by the ~t80 death (she stops dealing/healing early). Refines the survival model: the WR-critical requirement is carry protection (low-taken on Ezio/Bambus/Pelops), not 5/5 survival. ⭐ MECHANISM (first-party): support survival is a RACE against PELOPS'S TAUNT COOLDOWN. Tagoar died on the LAST attack BEFORE Pelops's Taunt came back up — i.e. she was killed during the Taunt-DOWN window when the swarm was free to target a support. On OTHER runs Tagoar LIVES with a SLIVER of HP because Pelops re-pulls aggro with Taunt just in time. So who-dies (and thus the win) hinges on the knife-edge timing of Taunt re-cast vs support HP depletion during the gap — the sim must model Taunt cadence (A3 cd4/dur2, ~43% uptime) AND heal throughput accurately, because a small error flips 'survives with a sliver' ↔ 'dies'.

So the Artak team RANGE = clears 13-17 fast (50-64t), with 17 the knife-edge wall (vs Alice team walling 14). Artak is both the scaling carry AND the survival anchor at the top.

⭐ FRONTIER PINNED: St17 DEFEAT (no reward) right after the barely-win — St17 is the Artak team WIN/LOSS EDGE (1W/1L, the highest-value calibration point: same team both outcomes). Time 1:58; turns not shown on defeat screen. Artak TOPS even in the loss (3,468,724 — the carry regardless of outcome). Team-total ~4.43M. Everyone worn down (~33-36k taken each).
